chunks: Ali narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Regarding a man and his wife upon whom a house falls.

He said: 'The wife inherits from the man, and the man inherits from the wife.' Its meaning is that they inherit from each other from the substance of their own wealth; they do not inherit from each other's share of what is jointly inherited.
ai.seo_question: How do husband and wife inherit from each other if they die at the same time?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that in simultaneous death, spouses inherit from each other's individual assets but not from the mutual inheritance pool, thereby avoiding circularity. This ruling, found in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, reflects the Shia jurisprudential approach to resolving the 'simultaneous death' (*mawt al-tawa'*) dilemma by distinguishing between personal estate and shared inheritance shares.
